summary: Iteration 4 retest of ChatConsole slash-command dispatcher fix. All 7 commands now route through handleCommand() and PASS: /help renders local [CMD] menu (no LLM hallucination), /remember writes to Mongo and is verified via GET /api/memory, /memory prints [MEMORY N stored — showing X] block, /forget <id-prefix> wipes one entry with [MEMORY-WIPE] forgot, /clear-memory prints [MEMORY-WIPE] erased N fragments, /watch <yt-url> auto-flips center deck to OBSERVE tab and [data-testid=observation-iframe] renders, /stop-watch removes iframe and prints [OPTICAL] viewport cleared. End-to-end backend integration confirmed (POST/DELETE /api/memory). One minor cosmetic regression: /watch passes the raw youtube watch?v= URL straight into the iframe, bypassing ObservationScreen.normalize(), so YouTube blocks the embed via X-Frame-Options (iframe element exists, video does not play). The load-button path (paste URL + click WATCH) still normalizes correctly.

integration_issues.flow: /watch <youtube-watch-url> — iframe renders but YouTube refuses to display (X-Frame-Options sameorigin)
integration_issues.issue: ChatConsole /watch handler calls watchUrl?.(rest) with the raw URL. ObservationScreen receives it as the `url` prop and sets iframe src directly without re-running normalize(). normalize() is only invoked from the inline URL input's onLoad. Effect: typing /watch https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw produces an iframe with src=...watch?v=... which YouTube blocks. The functional acceptance criteria (tab switch + iframe element appears) is satisfied; but the video itself is blank.

action_items: (Minor) In ObservationScreen, run normalize() on the incoming `url` prop (e.g., useMemo or a useEffect that setUrl(normalize(propUrl))), so the /watch slash command produces the same /embed/<id> iframe as the WATCH button path. Without this, /watch <youtube watch URL> shows an empty iframe due to X-Frame-Options.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified: ChatConsole.jsx lines 151-155 now short-circuit slash input into handleCommand() before reaching the LLM /api/chat path. Single-echo confirmed (handleCommand pushes the operator echo; send() returns before the duplicate /api/chat user push).
ObservationScreen URL normalization is local to the inline input — /watch command bypasses it. Centralize normalize() at the prop boundary so both entry points share behavior.

success_rate.backend: 100% (regression suite from iteration 3 still green; no backend code changed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 7 slash-command acceptance criteria. One follow-up cosmetic item on /watch iframe normalization.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Slash-command dispatcher in ChatConsole is fully wired and working. All 7 commands verified end-to-end against live backend (https://quantum-mind-os-2.preview.emergentagent.com). Only outstanding nit is ObservationScreen.normalize() not being applied to the `url` prop coming from /watch — iframe element renders correctly, but YouTube blocks the watch?v= form. Easy fix: useEffect(() => setUrl(normalize(propUrl)), [propUrl]) inside ObservationScreen, or normalize at watchUrl call site in ChatConsole. data-testids confirmed in play: chat-input, chat-send-btn, center-tab-observe, observation-iframe, open-memory-btn.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 3 RCA was correct. Iteration 4 applied fix (6 lines added to top of send()): `if (text.startsWith('/')) { setInput(''); await handleCommand(text); return; }`. Reproduction of fix: typed each of the 7 commands in [data-testid=chat-input] and clicked [data-testid=chat-send-btn] — every command now produced its expected local [SYS]-tagged response instead of an LLM-generated message. GET /api/memory confirmed 1 item after /remember and 0 items after /clear-memory. iframe src=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw after /watch, removed after /stop-watch.
